why: The hut on chicken legs is the old folk magic in miniature, wild and clever, and it sweeps its own footprints away, which is the wink I look for.
style: Every pet has a bold ink outline and one ornamental border motif, and nothing is worn like a costume.
making: Worry: nineteen separate drawings may drift toward costume-shop cute, so the Lamp's review should reject any pet that looks worn, not drawn.
